dependencyEvidence.scope: Observed fixed resource-limited commands and engine language-directory output. SHA256 file snapshots before and after measurement, not continuous file-open attestation. Does not identify every shared library or Python package.
dependencyEvidence.discovery: Successful fixed-engine --list-langs stdout, never an engine-version lookup.

nativeProcess.scope: Linux /proc child VmRSS/VmHWM sampled every 10 ms. Observed lower bound, not a complete kernel peak. Does not sum concurrent descendants. Parent memory is separate.

nodeProcess.scope: Node parent only. Does not measure native child CPU or peak RSS. Dependency file snapshot collection is outside this measurement.

report.scope: Synthetic stress conditions only. Not a real-world accuracy estimate. Measurement completion is not a passing accuracy claim.

scope: Source-bound CI measurement. Stable dependency snapshots pass identity provenance, while 21 nonexact synthetic images retain accuracy FAIL. No field-photo or native-isolation acceptance follows. Benchmark images add no product goal credit.
